description: This PHP file defines the 'Builder' class within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Tree' namespace. The class provides static methods to build, manage, and organize a hierarchical file tree structure, including functions for ignoring specific files, creating content objects from files, and sorting the tree. It is used for generating navigable documentation trees from file directories.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A utility class containing static methods for constructing and manipulating a documentation tree from filesystem directories and files.

methods.name: isIgnored
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory should be ignored based on predefined paths or user-provided ignore rules.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the filename without extension from a given path.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Recursively builds a directory tree structure, creating Directory, Content, or Raw objects based on filesystem entries.

methods.name: createContent
methods.description: Creates a Content or Raw object based on file extension and configuration, for inclusion in the directory tree.

methods.name: removeSortingInformations
methods.description: Removes numeric prefixes or sorting information from filenames.

methods.name: getOrCreateDir
methods.description: Finds or creates a Directory object within a parent directory based on a given title.

methods.name: getOrCreatePage
methods.description: Finds or creates a page object (Content or ComputedRaw) in a directory based on filename/path.

methods.name: sortTree
methods.description: Recursively sorts directories and their entries.

methods.name: finalizeTree
methods.description: Assigns previous and next links among Content objects in the tree for navigation purposes.
